rationale: The assistant correctly tied the split seal, failed paper test and frost location to the cause and recommended a freezer door seal ordered by model and service number, with defrost-first advice. Minor issues: unverified claims such as 'Most Indesit seals push into a groove', price ranges, and the tape fix and hairdryer reshaping suggestions, plus the assumption that the model has multiple versions. It did not name a specific part number and told the customer to confirm the fit using the rating plate details, so compatibility was not overclaimed.
